reason: Better Auth's own endpoints (sign in, sign out, session): this route IS the authentication surface, so it is public by design.
OAuth 2.0 authorize endpoint for the MCP server: it only redirects the browser into the sign-in and consent flow; no token is issued without signing in.
Liveness probe by design: returns only ok and the build revision — no database, settings or secret values.
Public website media: serves only assets stored as public site content (findServableAsset with the public scope); private assets are served by the guarded desk route.
